explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 59 named tracks, releases, reviews and catalogue references across the live September 2026 Boomkat, Resident Advisor and Bandcamp windows; Alexander Holm's current Stroom edition; adjacent Metempsychosis material; Planet Rhythm's 2026 catalogue; and current canonical inside-out boundaries. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 168–190 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.
Already-recorded Carmen Villain, Loidis, Ploy, Mark Fell, December, D1, Confusion and other recent fields were excluded from the request even where current coverage recurred.
The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 51-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
